title: Local steering laws for rigid multi-robot payload transport: a replicated benchmark from kinematics to physics (code, scenarios, configurations and results)
description: Code, scenario files (SDF worlds and JSON traffic contracts), configurations, trained model weights and derived results of the benchmark. Two archives: the core release and the per-step run logs. Every file is listed with its SHA-256 in MANIFEST.sha256. Simulation study; no hardware data.
